status: unfrozen source proposal; no validator, writer or executing result
adoption_gates: Core accepts the proposed closed retry_disposition fields and normalized snapshot/range binding
Server binds the full HTTP envelope/refusal matrix to the installed future prepared implementation
Native implements the prepared role and validator/transaction writer before advertisement
Actual native/database/SDK/installed qualification and release remain separate

mode_gate.unanchored_record_local_activity_batch: version 1 only; never reinterpreted as an anchored version-2 result

prepared_report.boundary: report object passed to the existing per-attempt recordLocalActivityOutcome flow; not the 11-field record_local_activity batch
prepared_report.unknown_members: refuse before publication or a further callback

completed.result: existing validated encoded Avro result; codec must resolve to avro

failed.exception_type: existing nonblank UTF-8 string, at most 255 bytes; existing RuntimeException default if absent
failed.non_retryable: Boolean only; existing false default if absent
failed.next_retry_delay_seconds: optional actual JSON integer in [0,9007199254740991]; null/Boolean/string/floating lexeme/refused

timed_out.classification: engine-owned and actually due; no worker override, timeout kind, delay or failure timestamp

clock.sample: one engine UTC sample after strict request validation and canonical authority locks; the same sample drives fresh temporal fences and the retry decision
clock.publication: retained only with the first transaction that commits; rollback publishes neither a sample nor decision
clock.duplicate: return the matching committed per-attempt receipt and decision; never resample or rerun policy for that receipt
clock.original_deadline: stored prepared execution schedule_to_close_deadline_at, checked against correlated original preparation/start authority
clock.serialization: UTC RFC3339 with exactly six fractional digits and Z; nullable original schedule-to-close deadline
clock.prepared_timeout_projection: preserve actual engine timeout precedence; start_to_close/heartbeat with remaining total time and attempt budget may retry under policy; actually due schedule_to_close terminates before application override selection
precedence: fresh original claim and temporal fences using one sample

retry_disposition_proposal.boundary: engine-owned object shared exactly by the stored outcome metadata and its prepared receipt; never accepted in a worker report

common_required.failure_time: the stored first accepted engine sample

common_optional.requested_delay_seconds: present iff the valid failed report supplied next_retry_delay_seconds; exact requested integer, including zero; diagnostic input does not prove application

scheduled_required.retry_available_at: checked failure_time plus selected seconds, strictly before original deadline if set
scheduled_required.delay_source: policy or failure_override; engine timeouts always policy

retry_disposition_proposal.unknown_members: refused by a future consumer; never silently ignored

conditional_common.timeout_kind: required iff failure_source is engine_timeout; one of start_to_close, schedule_to_close, heartbeat; forbidden otherwise

retry_disposition_proposal.delay_source_rule: failure_override only for a still-admitted application failure with a supplied valid override; otherwise policy. A preempted application override stays requested diagnostic input only.
retry_disposition_proposal.engine_timeout_terminal_classification: reserved for overall schedule_to_close expiry; start_to_close/heartbeat before the total deadline may schedule the policy retry or terminate under their actual budget/cap/deadline branch

engine_receipt_proposal.retry_disposition_present: for a version-2 failed/timeout engine outcome; absent for a genuinely completed outcome

scheduled.created_task_ids: exactly one retained retry workflow task ID

engine_receipt_proposal.http_boundary: this closes the engine receipt object only; controller history_refresh_page_token, protocol envelope and refusal HTTP status/body require their own exact source binding before adoption

history.identity: same run/execution/real attempt/worker attempt/original task epoch as the prepared outcome receipt
history.scheduled: one ActivityRetryScheduled for the real failed attempt, with matching stored retry_disposition, retry_available_at and actual selected retry_backoff_seconds; no following attempt exists until independently prepared
history.terminal: one existing ActivityFailed or ActivityTimedOut outcome for the real attempt; matching retry_disposition; no retry task, following attempt/start or ActivityRetryScheduled
history.failure_preservation: cap/deadline retry termination preserves the admitted application failure/type; already-due engine timeout preserves engine timeout provenance instead
history.cold_replay: consume the stored decision and availability; do not evaluate the current policy or clock
history.timeout_scheduled: an actual pre-total-deadline start_to_close/heartbeat timeout may record ActivityRetryScheduled with retry_reason timeout, actual timeout_kind and policy-selected delay; no worker override is applied

ranges.checked_selection: a selected retry must also fit the backend duration arithmetic and resulting bindable UTC timestamp before writes; no wrap, clamp, float coercion or immediate fallback
ranges.terminal_candidate: a portable diagnostic integer is not an executed duration or retry availability
ranges.remaining_snapshot_binding: Core proposed the exact ten-key snapshot, new-route bounds and closed policy above; final joint source reconciliation remains before freeze

carrier.execution: v1 unprepared batch with otherwise plausible duration reports

carrier.sample: maximum bindable backend instant minus 500000 microseconds

carrier.condition: selected duration or resulting backend timestamp not representable

carrier.two_valid_fenced_outcomes: same original attempt and normalized report
same original attempt, distinct valid override integers

carrier.result: otherwise valid independently encoded Avro result

carrier.all_entries: valid and no larger than supplied finite cap

carrier.boundary: authoring expansion before flattened worker wire

required.backoff_seconds: ordered list of 0..1024 actual integers in 0..9007199254740991

optional.non_retryable_error_types: 0..128 valid UTF-8 nonblank strings, each <=255 bytes before existing trim/first-occurrence deduplication; default []

prepared_policy_proposal.unknown_members: refuse, including snapshot_version and generator descriptors
prepared_policy_proposal.generator_boundary: bounded authoring expansion precedes the wire; do not infer or reconstruct a generator from a flattened worker list
prepared_policy_proposal.flattened_generated_wire_tail: the shared <=1024 list bound is intentional; retain every admitted supplied entry, including unused tails; no inferred max_attempts-1 exact-length wire restriction

required.backoff_seconds: ordered list of 0..1024 actual integers in 0..9007199254740991
required.non_retryable_error_types: ordered list of 0..128 normalized error types, each valid UTF-8 nonblank <=255 original bytes

stored_snapshot_proposal.unlimited_null_or_sentinel_attempt_budge: not part of version 2; preserve existing legacy path
stored_snapshot_proposal.preparation_deadlines: checked backend timestamp arithmetic before the original execution/start authority is published
